Recycling

Your Used Caging Belongs in a Recycling Loop, Not a Landfill

Innovive's EU recycling program collects used disposable caging from research facilities across Europe and ensures 100% of plastic materials are recycled. No incineration. No landfill. A fully circular end-of-life for every Innovive cage your facility uses. Ask About Availability The Problem

Disposable Should Not Mean Wasteful

Disposable IVC caging delivers real operational and animal welfare benefits. But without a proper end-of-life program, single-use plastic creates a sustainability problem that research institutions are increasingly accountable for.
Incinerating used caging produces emissions. Sending it to landfill is a regulatory and reputational risk in many EU jurisdictions. Neither option aligns with the sustainability commitments that pharmaceutical companies, universities, and CROs are expected to meet.
The Innovive EU recycling program closes the loop. Used caging that was never going to be washed and reused is instead collected, processed, and returned to production as recycled material. The plastic that housed your animals funds the next generation of caging. How EU Recycling Program Works

Simple for Your Facility. Thorough on Our End.

The program is designed to require minimal operational change at your facility. Used caging is already double-bagged when it arrives. The collection process fits into your existing waste management workflow.

At Your Facility

Used disposable cages are re-stacked with soiled bedding intact and resealed in their original bags. The sealed bags go to your facility's recycling dock. No dumping required.

Collection

Innovive works with validated partner networks across the EU to coordinate pickup. Scheduling is arranged to fit your facility's operational calendar.

Processing

Used product is sent to specialized plastic recycling facilities that have validated Innovive's PET caging materials. Plastic is mechanically cleaned, sorted, and re-processed into recycled material for use in new caging or equivalent products.

What We Accept

Cage bottoms (with or without soiled bedding), Cage lids, Aquavive water bottles, Feeders, Cardholders, Enrichment plastics. All Innovive IVC caging is made from RIC 1 PET plastic, free of contaminants and fully compatible with mechanical recycling processes.

Why This Matters for Your Facility

Measurable Sustainability, Documented

Research facilities in the EU face increasing pressure to demonstrate sustainability performance from funders, institutional policies, and regulatory frameworks. Plastic waste is a visible and auditable metric.The Innovive recycling program gives your facility a documented zero-landfill outcome for all caging waste. We work with our partner network to provide collection records that support your sustainability reporting.Program Features:
  • Partner networks active across the EU
  • Customized pricing tailored to facility volume and geography
  • No sorting or dumping required at your site
  • Fully documented material processing for compliance and reporting

Check Availability in Your Region

The EU recycling program is available at research facilities across multiple EU countries and continues to expand through our regional partner network. Contact us to confirm availability in your region and receive a customized quote.
This is the same closed-loop commitment that drives our North American InnoCycle program, adapted for European operations and regulatory requirements. Ask About EU Recycling Availability Contact Our Sustainability Team
